english:
<primary/>Primary Ammo weapon kills grant a stack of 'Primary Chain'. Maximum of 3 stacks. Stacks are only lost on death.

Each stack grants 5 Mobility and gives <primary/>Primary Ammo weapons 5 Range and 15 Handling. At 3 stacks, these bonuses reach 15 Mobility, 15 Range, and 45 Handling.

source.text:
2 Piece | Primary Chain

On Primary Ammo Weapon Kill:
Grants a stack of Primary Chain, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
Stacks are only lost on death.

Primary Chain | +5 Mobility, +5 Range, and +15 Handling for Primary Ammo Weapons per stack.
Maxes out at +15 Mobility, +15 Range, and +45 Handling after scoring 3 Primary Ammo Weapon Kills.
